title: Power Apps: GitHub models and wider availability for the generative page agent in Maker Studio
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned GitHub model access and credit consumption. Both tenant-control paths are documented, and the briefing correctly distinguishes those existing controls from the still-undocumented controls, billing details and processing boundaries of the planned generative-page integration.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented the processing locations and boundaries of the planned generative-page GitHub connection.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented which inputs the planned generative-page connection sends to GitHub.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "data" "processed". Opened generative-pages, faq-generative-pages-model-driven and canvas-authoring-agent. The latter documents prompts and application context for canvas authoring, not this planned generative-page connection.

claims.claim: Detailed billing arrangements for the planned generative-page GitHub connection are not yet published.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a Power Platform meter for this planned GitHub model-access path.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "licensing" "credits"; "generative pages" "GitHub" "billing" "meter". Opened generative-pages, pricing-billing-skus and pay-as-you-go-meters. No meter for this authoring connection; general app-runtime meters do not establish one.
